title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA-1997 year. Karnataka reported the highest number of cases (668) amongst all the States & UTs during this year accounting for 30.0 per cent of the total cases reported in the country. The other States which recorded higher incidence of such crimes were; Rajasthan (423) and Tamil Nadu (245). The crime rate (1.3) was the highest in Karnataka and Pondicherry against the national average of 0.2.
